Quillon Transact valuation snapshot

Quillon Transact trades at 3.5x EV/revenue on 2025 revenue. Analysts cite slower growth.

The discount to peers has persisted since its point-of-sale hardware business lost share.

Quillon Transact is a fictional company used in a software demonstration.
